# BPCS Interlock Record: Template and Worked Example

This set has five parts:

1. Program rules that keep setpoints in one place.
2. The blank template, one record per interlock.
3. A filled example for IL-H1100-01, low fuel gas pressure on PT-1105 closing XV-1106.
4. The setpoint register excerpt for the example.
5. Open items.

**Classification flag before you use the example.** On many refinery fired heaters, low fuel gas pressure is a BMS/SIS function under API 556 and the site LOPA. It is not a BPCS interlock there. Confirm this for each heater before you migrate the interlock as BPCS. The template has a classification field that blocks the record until someone confirms it (see OI-01).

---

## 1. Program rules (apply to all 40 units)

| Rule ID | Rule |
|---|---|
| PR-01 | The **setpoint register** is the only place that holds a numeric value: trip points, delays, timers, stroke limits, bypass limits, alarm limits. |
| PR-02 | Interlock records, C&E charts, FAT procedures, and HMI help cite the **SP ID** only. A C&E cell shows "SP-1105-01", not "0.30 barg". |
| PR-03 | The configurer loads values from a register export. FAT includes one step that compares each configured value with the register (see T-00 in the example). |
| PR-04 | The register status for each value is one of: `legacy` (as-found in old DCS), `provisional`, `confirmed`, `as-built`. Only `confirmed` values go to FAT. |
| PR-05 | The register records the legacy value once, in its own column. Discrepancies between legacy drawings and logic printouts go in the interlock record, Section K. They do not go in a second value. |
| PR-06 | After construction starts, all changes go through MOC. The register and record each carry a revision and a change log. |
| PR-07 | Each requirement has an ID `FR-<module>-NNN` and at least one FAT step. A requirement without a test step is rewritten or removed. |

---

## 2. Template: BPCS Interlock Record

> Copy one record per interlock. Fields in *italics* are guidance. Delete the guidance when you fill it in.

### A. Identification

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Interlock ID | *IL-<unit/equipment>-NN* |
| Title | *Short: "<equipment> <variable> <direction> trip"* |
| Equipment module | *Tag of the module (heater, pump, compressor)* |
| Record revision / MOC no. | |
| Related C&E chart / row | *Drawing no. and row; the row is written in Section F* |

### B. Classification (gate: do not configure until complete)

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Class | *BPCS interlock / BPCS IPL (credited in LOPA) / SIF (stop: goes to SRS)* |
| Basis | *HAZOP node, LOPA scenario ID, or "not credited"* |
| If BPCS IPL: independence | *Confirm that the initiator, logic solver, and final element are independent of the initiating cause (IEC 61511-1 cl. 9.3)* |
| Confirmed by / date | *Process safety engineer* |

### C. Purpose

*One or two sentences: what hazard or equipment damage this prevents.*

### D. Cause (initiator)

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Initiator tag(s) | |
| Condition | *"below" / "above" / "state ="* |
| Trip setpoint | *SP ID only* |
| Trip delay (debounce) | *SP ID only* |
| Voting | *1oo1, 2oo3, ...* |
| Bad PV response | *Trip / hold last / alarm only; state why* |
| Initiator location | *P&ID ref; upstream/downstream of which valve* |

### E. Effects (final elements and other actions)

| Effect no. | Tag | Action on trip | Fail position (power / air / signal loss) | Position feedback | Verify-time SP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | | | | | |

*Include controller actions too (force to manual, output tracking). These prevent a bump on restart.*

### F. C&E row (written here when no chart exists)

| Cause | Effect | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|

### G. States and transitions (ISA-106)

| State | Entry condition | Allowed exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ARMED | | | | |
| TRIPPED | | | | |
| RESET-READY | | | | |
| START-OVERRIDE (if used) | | | | |
| BYPASSED (if allowed) | | | | |

### H. Requirements

| Req ID | Requirement (STE, one action per sentence) | FAT step |
|---|---|---|

*Cover each of these:*

- Cause and trip delay.
- Bad PV.
- Each effect.
- Effect verification.
- Latch.
- Reset permissives.
- No auto-restart.
- Start override.
- Bypass.
- First-out.
- Pre-alarm.
- Comms/I/O loss.
- Controller restart.
- Power loss.

### I. Alarms

| Alarm tag | Condition | Limit (SP ID) | Operator response | Alarm DB ref |
|---|---|---|---|---|

*Priority comes from the rationalized alarm database. Do not set it here.*

### J. Operator interface

*List what the operator sees, what the operator can change, and what the operator is prompted for. Include the role or key needed for reset and bypass.*

### K. Migration traceability

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Legacy C&E drawing / row | |
| Legacy logic printout (page, block) | |
| As-found behavior in old DCS | *Describe behavior. Do not record values here; the register holds them.* |
| Discrepancies found | *Drawing vs. logic vs. field* |
| Resolution / decided by | |

### L. FAT test steps

| Step | Action | Expected result | Req ID |
|---|---|---|---|

*Testers read SP values from the register revision named on the FAT cover sheet. They record the as-tested value in the result column.*

### M. Sign-off

| Role | Name | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Process engineer (author) | | |
| Controls engineer (review) | | |
| Operations (states, prompts, reset, bypass) | | |
| Process safety (Section B) | | |

## 3. Example: IL-H1100-01, Heater Low Fuel Gas Pressure Trip

*Assumed tags (confirm in OI-02):*

| Tag | Assumed function |
|---|---|
| H-1100 | Heater |
| XY-1106 | Solenoid on XV-1106 |
| ZSC-1106 | XV-1106 closed limit switch |
| ZSO-1106 | XV-1106 open limit switch |
| PIC-1105 / PV-1105 | Fuel gas pressure controller and its valve |

### A. Identification

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Interlock ID | IL-H1100-01 |
| Title | H-1100 fuel gas pressure low trip |
| Equipment module | H-1100 |
| Record revision / MOC no. | Rev A (draft) / MOC not yet required |
| Related C&E chart / row | New C&E H-1100, row 01 (legacy ref in Section K) |

### B. Classification

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Class | BPCS interlock, **pending confirmation** |
| Basis | TBD: HAZOP node and LOPA scenario (OI-01) |
| If BPCS IPL: independence | Not applicable unless LOPA credits it |
| Confirmed by / date | Open (OI-01) |

### C. Purpose

The trip closes the main fuel gas supply when burner fuel gas pressure is too low for stable combustion. This prevents flame instability, flameout, and fuel accumulation in the firebox.

### D. Cause

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Initiator tag | PT-1105 |
| Condition | PV below trip setpoint |
| Trip setpoint | SP-1105-01 |
| Trip delay | SP-1105-03 |
| Voting | 1oo1 |
| Bad PV response | Trip, with no delay. Reason: loss of the only pressure measurement removes the protection. |
| Initiator location | Downstream of XV-1106 and PV-1105, at the burner header (assumed; OI-03) |

### E. Effects

| Effect no. | Tag | Action on trip | Fail position | Position feedback | Verify-time SP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | XY-1106 → XV-1106 | De-energize. XV-1106 closes. | Closed on loss of power, air, or signal | ZSC-1106 | SP-1105-06 |
| E2 | PIC-1105 | Set to MAN. Set output to the trip output. | PV-1105 fail position per instrument index (OI-02) | n/a | n/a |
| E3 | H-1100 first-out | Record IL-H1100-01 if it is first | n/a | n/a | n/a |

Pilot gas is not an effect of this interlock. Pilots stay lit (confirm in OI-04).

### F. C&E row

| Cause | Effect | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|
| PT-1105 below SP-1105-01 for SP-1105-03, or PT-1105 bad quality | E1 close XV-1106; E2 PIC-1105 to MAN at trip output; E3 first-out | Latched | Operator RESET on IL-H1100-01 faceplate (role: Board Operator) when reset permissives are met. XV-1106 then opens only on a separate operator OPEN command. |

### G. States and transitions

| State | Entry condition | Allowed exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ARMED | From START-OVERRIDE when PT-1105 is at or above SP-1105-01 before the timer ends | → TRIPPED (cause true), → BYPASSED | Auto | Automatic |
| TRIPPED | Cause true in ARMED; bad PV in any state except BYPASSED; controller restart; override timer expires with cause true | → RESET-READY | Auto | Automatic |
| RESET-READY | Operator pushes RESET with permissives met: PT-1105 good quality, ZSC-1106 made, XV-1106 command = CLOSE | → START-OVERRIDE (operator OPEN), → TRIPPED (bad PV or ZSC-1106 lost) | Operator | Operator-prompted |
| START-OVERRIDE | Operator commands XV-1106 OPEN from RESET-READY. Override timer SP-1105-04 starts. Low-pressure cause is ignored; bad PV is not ignored. | → ARMED (PT-1105 at or above SP-1105-01 before timer ends), → TRIPPED (timer ends with PT-1105 below SP-1105-01, or bad PV) | Operator start, auto exit | Automatic |
| BYPASSED | Authorized bypass applied from ARMED | → ARMED (bypass removed or SP-1105-07 expires; trip occurs at once if cause is true) | Operator (Shift Supervisor role) | Manual |

### H. Requirements

| Req ID | Requirement | FAT step |
|---|---|---|
| FR-H1100-101 | When PT-1105 stays below SP-1105-01 for SP-1105-03, trip IL-H1100-01. | T-01 |
| FR-H1100-102 | When PT-1105 recovers within SP-1105-03, do not trip. | T-02 |
| FR-H1100-103 | When PT-1105 quality goes bad, trip IL-H1100-01 with no delay. | T-03 |
| FR-H1100-104 | Bad quality is outside SP-CP-001 to SP-CP-002. | T-03 |
| FR-H1100-105 | On trip, de-energize XY-1106. | T-01 |
| FR-H1100-106 | On trip, set PIC-1105 to MAN. | T-01 |
| FR-H1100-107 | On trip, set the PIC-1105 output to SP-1105-08. | T-01 |
| FR-H1100-108 | If ZSC-1106 is not made within SP-1105-06 after trip, raise alarm XA-1106. | T-04 |
| FR-H1100-109 | Keep the trip latched after the cause clears. | T-05 |
| FR-H1100-110 | Accept RESET only when PT-1105 is good quality, ZSC-1106 is made, and the XV-1106 command is CLOSE. | T-06 |
| FR-H1100-111 | Do not open XV-1106 automatically after RESET. | T-06 |
| FR-H1100-112 | Do not put PIC-1105 in AUTO automatically after RESET. | T-06 |
| FR-H1100-113 | On operator OPEN after RESET, ignore the low-pressure cause for SP-1105-04 only. | T-07 |
| FR-H1100-114 | If PT-1105 is below SP-1105-01 when SP-1105-04 ends, trip again. | T-08 |
| FR-H1100-115 | During START-OVERRIDE, trip on bad PV. | T-08 |
| FR-H1100-116 | Record IL-H1100-01 in the H-1100 first-out display when it trips first. | T-01 |
| FR-H1100-117 | On controller cold or warm restart, start IL-H1100-01 in TRIPPED. | T-09 |
| FR-H1100-118 | On loss of the XY-1106 output channel, card, or controller comms, de-energize XY-1106. | T-10 |
| FR-H1100-119 | Allow bypass of the PT-1105 cause only, by the Shift Supervisor role. | T-11 |
| FR-H1100-120 | While bypassed, show alarm XB-1105. | T-11 |
| FR-H1100-121 | Remove the bypass automatically when SP-1105-07 expires. | T-11 |
| FR-H1100-122 | Bypass does not block an operator CLOSE of XV-1106. | T-11 |
| FR-H1100-123 | Raise PAL-1105 when PT-1105 is below SP-1105-02 in ARMED. | T-12 |
| FR-H1100-124 | Make sure the configured values equal the register values for all SP IDs in this record. | T-00 |

Power loss: XV-1106 fails closed by spring return (E1). On restoration, FR-H1100-117 applies.

### I. Alarms (no rationalized database given; add these to it)

| Alarm tag | Condition | Limit (SP ID) | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|
| PAL-1105 | PT-1105 low, pre-trip | SP-1105-02 | Check fuel gas supply and PIC-1105. Reduce firing if pressure continues to fall. |
| XA-1105T | IL-H1100-01 tripped | SP-1105-01 | Make sure XV-1106 is closed. Make sure pilots are lit. Find the cause before reset. |
| PA-1105B | PT-1105 bad quality | SP-CP-001 / SP-CP-002 | Call instrument technician. Do not reset until PT-1105 is good. |
| XA-1106 | XV-1106 failed to close | SP-1105-06 | Close the manual block valve (tag TBD, OI-05). Isolate fuel gas. |
| XB-1105 | IL-H1100-01 bypass active | SP-1105-07 | Use compensating measures per bypass permit. |
| XA-1105O | Override timer expired with low pressure (re-trip) | SP-1105-04 | Check fuel gas supply and burner valves before a new attempt. |

### J. Operator interface

- **Faceplate shows:** state (ARMED / TRIPPED / RESET-READY / START-OVERRIDE / BYPASSED), PT-1105 value and quality, XV-1106 position, override time left, and bypass time left.
- **Board Operator can:** push RESET (enabled only when permissives are met), command XV-1106 OPEN/CLOSE, and put PIC-1105 in AUTO.
- **Shift Supervisor can:** apply or remove bypass (role-protected). Bypass entry requires a permit number.
- **Prompts:**
  - On RESET: "Make sure that pilots are lit. Push OPEN to start XV-1106."
  - At bypass expiry: the XB-1105 alarm clears and the cause is re-armed.
- Operations signs off on states, prompts, roles, and the override sequence (Section M).

### K. Migration traceability

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Legacy C&E drawing / row | TBD (OI-06) |
| Legacy logic printout | TBD (OI-06) |
| As-found behavior | To be captured. Check four things: whether it is latched, whether bad PV trips, whether a start override exists, and whether PIC-1105 is forced. |
| Discrepancies | To be recorded |
| Resolution / decided by | Process engineer + Operations |

### L. FAT test steps

*Setup: simulate PT-1105 at the I/O. Monitor XY-1106. Simulate ZSC-1106/ZSO-1106. Use register Rev ___.*

| Step | Action | Expected result | Req ID |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-00 | Compare each configured value for SP-1105-01…08 and SP-CP-001/002 with the register. | All equal. Record values. | 124 |
| T-01 | From ARMED, set PT-1105 below SP-1105-01. Hold longer than SP-1105-03. | Trip at SP-1105-03 ± scan time. XY-1106 de-energized. PIC-1105 in MAN at SP-1105-08. First-out shows IL-H1100-01. XA-1105T active. | 101, 105–107, 116 |
| T-02 | From ARMED, set PT-1105 below SP-1105-01 for less than SP-1105-03. Return it above. | No trip. | 102 |
| T-03 | From ARMED, drive the PT-1105 signal below SP-CP-001. Repeat above SP-CP-002. | Trip with no delay each time. PA-1105B active. | 103, 104 |
| T-04 | Trip. Hold ZSC-1106 not made. | XA-1106 at SP-1105-06. | 108 |
| T-05 | After T-01, return PT-1105 to normal. | Stays TRIPPED. | 109 |
| T-06 | Push RESET with each permissive false in turn, then all true. | RESET rejected until all true. Then RESET-READY. XV-1106 stays closed. PIC-1105 stays MAN. | 110–112 |
| T-07 | From RESET-READY, command OPEN. Hold PT-1105 below SP-1105-01, then raise it above before SP-1105-04 ends. | No trip during override. State goes to ARMED. | 113 |
| T-08 | Repeat T-07 but keep PT-1105 low. Repeat again with bad PV during override. | Trip at SP-1105-04 end. XA-1105O active. Bad PV trips at once. | 114, 115 |
| T-09 | Cold restart, then warm restart, the controller. | IL-H1100-01 in TRIPPED. XY-1106 de-energized. | 117 |
| T-10 | Remove the XY-1106 output card. Then break controller comms. | XY-1106 de-energized each time. | 118 |
| T-11 | Apply bypass as Board Operator, then as Shift Supervisor. With bypass active, set PT-1105 low, then command CLOSE. Let SP-1105-07 expire with PT-1105 low. | Rejected for Board Operator. XB-1105 active. No trip while bypassed. CLOSE works. Trip at expiry. | 119–122 |
| T-12 | From ARMED, set PT-1105 between SP-1105-01 and SP-1105-02. | PAL-1105 active. No trip. | 123 |

## 4. Setpoint register excerpt (SSoT for this example)

| SP ID | Tag | Parameter | Value | Units | Status | Source / note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SP-1105-01 | PT-1105 | Low fuel gas pressure trip | 0.30 | barg | provisional, confirm | Burner vendor minimum stable pressure plus margin |
| SP-1105-02 | PT-1105 | Low pressure pre-alarm (PAL-1105) | 0.50 | barg | provisional, confirm | Must allow operator response time before trip |
| SP-1105-03 | PT-1105 | Trip delay (debounce) | 2 | s | provisional, confirm | |
| SP-1105-04 | IL-H1100-01 | Start override time | 15 | s | provisional, confirm | Must not exceed main flame trial time from BMS vendor |
| SP-1105-05 | — | Reserved | — | — | — | |
| SP-1105-06 | XV-1106 | Close verify time | 5 | s | provisional, confirm | Valve stroke test + margin |
| SP-1105-07 | IL-H1100-01 | Maximum bypass duration | 8 | h | provisional, confirm | Site bypass procedure |
| SP-1105-08 | PIC-1105 | Output on trip | 0 | % | provisional, confirm | Restart ramp-up from minimum |
| SP-CP-001 | Plant-wide | Bad PV, low signal limit | 3.6 | mA | provisional, confirm | NAMUR NE43; control philosophy |
| SP-CP-002 | Plant-wide | Bad PV, high signal limit | 21.0 | mA | provisional, confirm | NAMUR NE43; control philosophy |

Add a "legacy value" column when you capture the as-found values from the old DCS (PR-05).
